items.title: Are you safe?
lines: If you are hurt or in danger, call the emergency number first.
You can call it from any phone, even without a SIM card.

items.title: On a borrowed phone or computer?
lines: Open a private window.
Sign out of every account when you are done.

items.title: Freeze your bank cards.
lines: Call your bank. The number is on the bank website and on the back of your card.
Or freeze the cards in your banking app on another device.
Ask about any payments made since the theft.

items.title: Block your SIM card.
items.time: About 10 minutes, plus time on hold
lines: Call your mobile operator from any phone.
Ask them to block the SIM.
Ask for a new SIM with the same number.
A blocked SIM cannot receive your login codes.

items.title: Lock your phone.
lines: On any phone or computer, open the page for your phone. Sign in.

lines.text: Choose Mark as lost. You do not need a code from your phone.

lines: The same page shows where the phone is. Do not go there yourself. Give the location to the police.

items.title: Change your email password.
lines: Start with email. Email can reset everything else.
Then choose Sign out of all other devices.
Next, change the passwords for your bank and social accounts.

items.title: Report the theft to the police.
lines: Get a copy of the report and a reference number.
Your insurer and your operator will ask for them.

lines.text: Bring the IMEI number if you can find it. It is on the phone box, and in your Apple account.
Bring the IMEI number if you can find it. It is on the phone box, and in your Google account.

items.title: Erase your phone.
items.time: When you are sure it is gone
lines: Use the same page you used to lock it. Choose Erase.
After you erase it, you may not see where it is.
Do not remove the phone from your account. Then it stays locked for the thief.
